# Maurice Jobst

> I am Maurice Jobst, a Senior Product & Program Leader in Frankfurt am Main, working on European payment sovereignty (EPI) at Cubic Transportation Systems. I have spent 15+ years in payments, fintech, cybersecurity and public-sector mobility, with regulated delivery under BaFin, DORA, MaRisk/BAIT and the EU AI Act across the last decade of it. I owned a company's whole product function at Oddspedia, and more recently led 20+ people across vendors and partner organizations through Germany's Deutschland-Ticket rollout, inside a €5M+ B2G portfolio.

Based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Languages: German, English. Open to: Principal-level product and leadership mandates where payments and AI governance meet regulated delivery: Head of Product, practice build-out, consulting engagement leadership. Rhein-Main on site, hybrid or remote Germany-wide, relocation for the right mandate. One month's notice.

## Case studies

- [Turning around a 3M-user public-transit platform through the Deutschland-Ticket](https://maurice-jobst.github.io/case-studies/deutschland-ticket-turnaround.html): How a 3M-user German public-transit platform went from 1.6 to 4.0 app-store stars and shipped the Deutschland-Ticket national rollout with zero downtime, by fixing the operating model before the app.
- [Turning a banking act into engineering specifications](https://maurice-jobst.github.io/case-studies/banking-act-to-specifications.html): How the German Banking Act became deterministic engineering specifications for audit-ready core banking on GCP under BaFin scrutiny, and why the same translation job is arriving again with PSD3 and the Payment Services Regulation.
- [Running a personal infrastructure estate like a regulated hub-and-spoke organization](https://maurice-jobst.github.io/case-studies/hub-and-spoke-estate.html): Running a personal infrastructure estate on one reconcile shape, hub-and-spoke doctrine and machine-checked conformance, and why a cooperative banking group or a KRITIS operator has the same problem at a different scale.

## Open source

- [ai-workbench](https://github.com/maurice-jobst/ai-workbench): A file-first system for running product-management work with an AI agent: markdown as state, deterministic checks, and a verification culture borrowed from compliance work.

## Questions and answers

### Who is Maurice Jobst?

Maurice Jobst is a Senior Product & Program Leader based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. He works on European payment sovereignty (EPI) at Cubic Transportation Systems and has spent 15+ years in payments, fintech, cybersecurity and public-sector mobility.

### What does Maurice Jobst work on?

He integrates European Payments Initiative (EPI) digital identity with account-centric transit infrastructure at Cubic Transportation Systems, and works on AI governance for regulated delivery. His doctrine is AI at the edges, deterministic core: agents draft and triage, while anything that must be reproducible stays a script.

### Which regulatory frameworks has he delivered under?

BaFin supervision and KWG for core banking, MiFID II for Tier-1 bank modernization, and DORA, KRITIS and NIS2 for operational resilience. He tracks the EU AI Act, PSD2/PSD3 and the Instant Payments Regulation for current work.

### What is his most cited result?

He took a 3M+ user German public-transit platform from 1.6 to 4.0 app-store stars and carried it through the Deutschland-Ticket national rollout with zero downtime. The client renewed €2M+ a year afterwards on the back of sustained SLA compliance.

### How much leadership scope has he carried?

Both kinds. As Head of Product Management at Oddspedia in 2018–2019 he owned the company's entire product function: 7–10 people across product, design/data and engineering, reporting to C-level, with hiring and exits in his hands. More recently he led 20+ people across vendors and partner organizations through the Deutschland-Ticket delivery governance with no disciplinary line at all, inside a €5M+ B2G portfolio. He also helped establish Hamburg as Cubic's EMEA Technology Competence Center, which operates today.

### What kind of role is he open to?

Principal-level product and leadership mandates where payments leadership and AI governance meet regulated-industry delivery: Head of Product, practice build-out, consulting engagement leadership. Frankfurt and the Rhein-Main region on site, hybrid or remote Germany-wide, relocation for the right mandate. He is available at one month's notice.

### Where can I see his work?

The three case studies on this site cover payments and regulatory translation, delivery-governance turnaround, and operating-model design. Beyond them: the GitHub profile at github.com/maurice-jobst, and the open-source ai-workbench repository, which publishes the research behind its own design including the two claims that failed verification.
